title: Single-Threaded Database Driver Bottleneck
pattern: Executing database clients or drivers on a single thread without connection pooling or asynchronous task scheduling for heavy query workloads.
why_bad: Performance collapse. Single-threaded drivers spend 100% of their time blocked on socket I/O, completely stalling transaction throughput and wasting server capacity [404, 554].
detection: Synchronous database library blocking main application event loops or using single-threaded query executors.
counterexample: Async database drivers executing queries concurrently across a pool of connection tasks.
fix: Use asynchronous, pooled connection libraries (like `sqlx` in Rust) to allow high-concurrency non-blocking database access.
source:
*Systems Performance (Gregg), p. 13 [404]*  
*Pragmatic Programmers - Release It! (Nygard), p. 81 [554]*
